blockers.title: Rollout section is missing
blockers.why: The checker reports no Rollout section, so there is no launch sequence, feature flag, rollback trigger or support enablement for a change that sends emails to billing owners.
blockers.fix: Add a Rollout section per the template: internal -> beta -> % ramp -> GA, a named flag, a rollback trigger (e.g. wrong or duplicate alert emails), and billing-support enablement.

blockers.title: Requirements cover only the happy path and R2 conflicts with a known risk
blockers.why: "Email sent within 1 hour of crossing" cannot be met when "Usage data is delayed up to 6 hours for some meters", and there are no edge cases (threshold already crossed when set, monthly reset, duplicate alerts, no billing owner or multiple owners, email bounce, permissions).
blockers.fix: Define the SLA relative to when usage data lands, add an edge-case/error-state list, and tighten R1's acceptance criteria beyond "Thresholds saved per account" (validation, limits, who can edit).

blockers.title: No guardrail metric
blockers.why: Both metrics measure upside only, so nothing tells you if alerts become noisy or inaccurate (e.g. unsubscribes, alert emails disputed as wrong).
blockers.fix: Add at least one guardrail with a baseline and threshold, such as alert-email unsubscribe/complaint rate or alert accuracy vs the billing dashboard.

improvements: Users: "Billing owners on usage-based plans" is thin; say whether other roles (admins, finance) should receive alerts.
Scope: separate v1 from later phases explicitly; good non-goals already listed.
Requirements: add non-functional needs (email localization/currency formatting, accessibility of the threshold settings UI).
Risks: the 6-hour delay risk needs a mitigation or fallback, not just an owner and date.
Add a Timeline section with milestones.
questions: Should the 1-hour alert SLA be measured from the usage event or from when the meter data is ingested?
Who receives alerts if an account has no billing owner or several?
Does an alert fire once per threshold per billing month, and what happens if a threshold is set below current month-to-date usage?
What is the answer to "Should we pre-set a default alert for new accounts?", since it affects the 50% adoption target?
